notablePrerequisites:
There is a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
You control a basic land.
description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Sigil Captain triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on the Saproling.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Saproling token, untapping a basic land.
Repeat.
